$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006). A clearance envelope has no constant defaults.
title: Clearances
description: 13.5: a `clearances` object maps envelope names (^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$) to clearance envelopes (FS-CORE-13.5.1). It appears only on door types, window types and extension elements. That each extent of an envelope is at least 1,280 (FS-CORE-13.2.2) is an invariant (FS-INV-505), not checked here.

envelope.title: Clearance envelope
envelope.description: 13.5: a box, in the frame of the element it belongs to, that names space the element needs kept clear.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: 13.5: why the space is kept clear. Always present.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: 13.5: the envelope's shape; "box" is the only shape of this draft. Always present.

min.description: 13.2, 13.5: the least local x, y and z. Always present.

max.description: 13.2, 13.5: the greatest local x, y and z. Always present.
